scope: One original complete owned key-profile migration; containing value/encoding/executor/native profiles also apply

units.archiveArtifacts: Distinct admitted archive dependency identities in the complete migration evidence closure, including roots; equal bytes under distinct identities remain distinct
units.archiveDependencyEdges: Every declared required artifact-reference occurrence enumerated across original admitted archive nodes; repeated references count separately
units.inventoryRows: Complete source live/omitted/reserved entry count across all affected bindings, including hidden integrity entries
units.inventoryBytes: Complete encoded original source inventory plus referenced original source/component artifacts loaded for this attempt; repeated owned copies also charge ownedBytes
units.workUnits: Bytes actually examined/copied by admitted identity conversion/comparison/archive processing; repeated work charges again. Native query/hash/sort/codec workspace has separate selected enforcement obligations
units.namespaceAndKeyBytes: Cumulative complete source/target full namespace/key carriers observed or produced by the attempt, including collisions and repeated real work
units.nativeStatements: Every actual native submission including metadata, chunks, source revalidation, staging, finalization and original containment observations
units.ownedBytes: All original request/source/target/report/receipt/adapter/decoder/private evidence buffers and still-owned uncertainty reservations
units.elapsedMilliseconds: Single original migration deadline from initial invocation through commit submission/outcome observation; no phase/reset timer
units.containmentMilliseconds: Original containment observation allowance; expiry preserves recovery custody and unknown outcome

callerLimitRule: Request inventoryRows/inventoryBytes/reportBytes/workUnits may only tighten exact same-unit registered limits; never establish or enlarge a resource profile
qualification: Proposed defaults, not native allocator/deadline/feasibility evidence. Independent dimensions and containing profiles all apply; reaching one ceiling does not fund another.
